name: YIELD
spec: downward-pointing white triangle with a wide red border and red legend YIELD
meaning: Slow down and give the right-of-way; stop if needed.

snippets.back: A backing driver must yield to vehicles and people on the street or sidewalk and remain ready to stop.
Yield to pedestrians in crosswalks and seek eye contact.
Bicyclists must yield to pedestrians and keep their bicycles in good condition.
Yield to approaching freeway traffic when entering, stopping if necessary while accounting for vehicles behind.
After stopping for a stop sign, check both directions for traffic and pedestrians and yield before entering.
A red-and-white yield sign requires slowing, checking both directions and yielding to traffic and pedestrians; stop when needed to avoid a conflict.
For a left turn from a two-way street onto a one-way street, signal at least one hundred feet ahead, yield to road users, check for pedestrians and turn into the first lane.
Before turning left, get into the proper lane early and yield to oncoming vehicles and pedestrians.

evidence: [sec08-card-sec08-F006 | AK p.38] A red-and-white yield sign requires slowing, checking both directions and yielding to traffic and pedestrians; stop when needed to avoid a conflict.
